risks.title: Refinance exit is unsupported
risks.message: The only exit stated is 'Refinance to a bank at the end of the term', with no supporting detail. The application gives no lease, tenancy or rental income for the industrial warehouse, and no borrower financials. Without these, the credit submission cannot show the loan would meet a mainstream lender's criteria at the end of the 24-month term. Because this loan is itself a refinance of $4,600,000 of existing debt, it is also worth asking why the borrower is not refinancing with a bank now. The loan amount of $5,200,000 is about $600,000 more than the existing debt being repaid, and the application does not say what that extra amount is for.
